regions.name: Baltimore County
regions.model_scope: Baltimore County independent 2024–25 regular MCAP grade-school district models: exact operational NCES LEA 2400120 / CCD native MD-03 / MSDE 03 identities. All 137 native E/M/EM profiles with positive September grades 3–8 and no high-grade row remain searchable. Original regular School_Level All Students All Grades Levels 3/4 published rates support 126 Math, 137 ELA and 126 independently fitted Combined results; 11 Math masks retain ELA. Precise same-year individual Early Attendance ratios use their own denominators. Accelerated Math courses and the applicable grade 6–7 waiver remain in native totals; DLM stays separate. High, mixed, primary, unknown, unmatched and closed records remain outside this point-only release. Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide.
regions.map_source: School coordinates and district boundaries are unavailable in the audited Baltimore County source release.
